text: Does the patient have any differences in the strength of pulses between his arms and legs, or any abdominal bruits? I also need to check if his lower extremity blood pressure is significantly lower than his upper extremity blood pressure. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram

text: RESULTS: Pulses: 2+ radial pulses and trace femoral pulses. Blood Pressure Differential: Upper extremities 150/80 mm Hg (Right), compared to lower values in lower extremities. text: The clinical picture of upper extremity hypertension, weak femoral pulses, and echocardiographic evidence of aortic narrowing confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Coarctation of the Aorta
